title: Substitute into the function
text: To find the y-coordinate, substitute x = 3 into f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 5. Calculate f(3) = (3)^2 - 6(3) + 5.

title: Determine maximum or minimum
text: Since a = 1 > 0, the parabola opens upward (concave up), meaning the turning point is a minimum. If a < 0, it would be a maximum.
